summary.text: Trenton Barnhart is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 3, listed with Pleasants County; the district covers Pleasants, Ritchie and Wood counties and part of Wirt. His legislative page lists him as vice chair of the Banking and Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Barnhart's page gives his birth date as November 12, 1996, and lists his occupation as banker.

It lists his affiliations as the West Virginia Farm Bureau, the NRA, the West Virginia Citizen's Defense League, the Pleasants County Republican Executive Committee and Constitutional Advocates Pleasants County.
Barnhart also serves on the Senate's Confirmations, Economic Development, Education, Energy, Industry and Mining, and Finance committees.
